tasks.title: Repair mutable bootstrap handling of generated tracked drift
tasks.phase: Supervisor Runtime / Source-only Mutable Bootstrap Repair
acceptance: Reproduce the exact bootstrap failure against a mutable linked worktree whose only tracked drift is an orchestrator-regenerated .orchestrator/task-briefs/*.md file.

Choose and document a source-only boundary that either prevents runtime task-brief generation from dirtying the mutable command checkout or safely separates provenance-verified generated task-brief drift from governed launch-source identity; do not broadly ignore tracked drift.

Continue to reject any tracked change to supervisor, watchdog, promotion, status-command, config-provisioning, or other governed launch sources, plus symlink, gitfile, Git identity, index, and staged drift hazards.

Prove the immutable candidate guard, mutable gitfile binding, config CAS, transaction ordering, rollback, and bytecode self-rejection suites remain green with a committed pre-review evidence manifest.

Perform no live config edit, direct process signal, manual checkout/reset/stash, candidate deletion, runtime promotion, supervisor scheduling change, or fleet-routing policy change; any later rollout is a separately authorized governed task.
tasks.summary: The authorized 5877b644 rollout retry failed closed before mutation because bootstrap mutable-incumbent validation rejects one tracked task brief that the orchestrator itself regenerated in the active dev-root. Repair only the source boundary and regression fixtures; do not weaken governed launch-source identity or touch live runtime.
